sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Use original installed Vitest4.1.11 with Node24.19.0; no installation or original-tree writes.

Minimal node config includes only the declared test extension (.test.ts or .test.mjs); omits renderer aliases, feature-wall define, DOM/host-port setup, execArgv and original extended timeouts. Reviewed closure does not depend on those facilities. No full-config or typecheck equivalence claimed.
isolationRationale: Creates only owned temporary package directories. Spawns short Node children containing fixed test snippets: emit usage then exit1, require a deliberately absent package, or exit0. No real daemon, PTY or service. Original cleanup removes owned directories only.
testEvidenceBoundary: Verifier unit behavior, not boot of a real packaged service. No executable architecture, OS, timeout/signal, credential or module-closure completeness proof.
